Question Choices: Select all of which fractions below are equal to 1/3 ~~2/6 | 3/9 | 2/3~~
Hints: Think about how much of the whole is shaded.
Solution: 2/6 simplifies to 1/3 by dividing both numbers by 2. 3/9 simplifies to 1/3 by dividing both by 3. But 2/3 is twice 1/3. Select 2/6 and 3/9.

Question Choices: Select TRUE or FALSE of the following statement. When the denominator stays the same, a larger numerator makes the fraction larger ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Hints: For the same whole or equal-sized wholes, equal denominators mean equal-sized pieces. Compare the numerators.
Solution: TRUE. With the same positive denominator, the unit fractions have equal size. A larger numerator counts more of those equal pieces, giving a larger fraction.

Question Choices: Select which fraction is smaller 6/8 or 6/10 ~~6/8 | 6/10~~
Hints: For the same whole or equal-sized wholes, a larger positive denominator means smaller pieces. Compare the same positive number of those pieces.
Solution: Tenths are smaller than eighths of the same whole. With six pieces in each, 6/10 < 6/8. Select 6/10.

Question Choices: Select which fraction is larger 3/7 or 3/5 ~~3/7 | 3/5~~
Hints: For the same whole or equal-sized wholes, a larger positive denominator means smaller pieces. Compare the same positive number of those pieces.
Solution: Fifths are larger than sevenths of the same whole. With three pieces in each, 3/5 > 3/7. Select 3/5.

Question Choices: Fill In the missing number in the fraction 1/4 = ?/8
Hints: Quarter means the whole is split into four equal parts.
Solution: To change 4 to 8, multiply by 2. Do the same to the numerator: 1 x 2 = 2. Thus 1/4 = 2/8.
